reader_summary.headline: After 150+ episodes on great companies, we tackle the granddaddy of them all — Berkshire Hathaway.
reader_summary.overview: After 150+ episodes on great companies, we tackle the granddaddy of them all — Berkshire Hathaway. One episode alone isn't nearly enough to do Warren and Poor Charlie justice, so today we present Part I: Warren's story. How did a folksy, middle-class kid from Omaha become the single greatest capitalist of all-time?

key_points.text: Why, like Jordan, did he retire (twice!) at the top of his game, only to reinvent himself and come back stronger than ever?
